problem_type: Small-cohort release health false stops and unreachable full rollout
symptom: Equivalent versions frequently stop, while missing secondary telemetry permanently prevents full rollout.
direct_cause: One historical point threshold ignores new-cohort uncertainty; every metric and pending policy blocks full.
class_root: Decision boundary does not distinguish credible regression, primary evidence, and secondary coverage.
affected_population: Future stable release promotions and daily health runs

external_sources.purpose: Original Newcombe 1998 pp.876–877 method 10 and Table II(a) [0.0524,0.3339]

invariants: All metric differences use both cohorts Wilson intervals via Newcombe method 10.
Stop requires n>=10, positive lower bound, at least 5 points and two identified failure sessions.
Full depends only on new observation dates, launches, primary image sample and primary unknown results, with no stop. Secondary gaps are disclosed.

door_reduction.why_not: aggregate.mjs is the production cached-report caller; health.node-test.mjs is its independent synthetic regression caller. Both must retain access to the same pure decision boundary.

generality_proof: All generation, local-rejection, update and Agent rows share compare; all consumers receive the same confidence interval, session guard and primary-only approval decision.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Separate credible stops, primary evidence deficits and secondary coverage for all callers.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses flattened real cached events and passes corrupt file count to the single decision boundary.
Reads report.versionHealth.stop for nonzero exit; terminal and Markdown render the same conclusion.

recurrence.reason: Every sparse version cohort and metric can trigger this decision error.
same_class_scan: rg buildVersionHealth healthOptions thresholds sessionId scripts/lib/intake-radar scripts/intake-radar*.mjs
flattenEvents retains sessionId through object spread; no fetch pipeline change required

prevention.invariant: Both cohort uncertainties and session spread are mandatory for stops; secondary absence cannot veto full.
prevention.failure_mode: Invalid counts/config rejected; primary unknown or corrupt cache yields insufficient evidence; stop remains nonzero at CLI.
prevention.strategy: Replace historical noise bands and global pending gates with a single interval and primary-evidence decision.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove maxIncrease history bands, approvalPending and secondary/old-cohort full-rollout sample gates in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Closed-form statistics over existing cache; no third-party runtime or new dependency.

migration: Existing cached envelopes retain sessionId; no cache schema or pipeline migration. Missing session IDs cannot prove two failure sessions.
residual_risks: Counts are events, not independent users; Wilson/Newcombe assumes binomial observations.
Multiple metric checks are not a familywise 5% guarantee; the requested 1000-trial check is per simulated metric.
Telemetry lacks patch versions, Agent turns and true post-install completion.
Same first-round cache was deleted; offline real-data verification requires the coordinator retained copy.
